items.ex_sentence: บ้านเช่าหลังนี้อยู่ในซอยหมายเลข {X}.

items.rule_gloss: A rooms of equal use plus B units for common areas make C units; per room = (C - B) / A
items.gloss_en: The rental house has A rooms using equal electricity. Corridor and parking lights used B more units. The whole bill totals C units. The house opposite used T units. How many units does each room use?
